# Onnesha Hospital Management System (OHMS) - System & Clinical Profile

> This document defines the official technical architecture and clinical profile for Onnesha Hospital & Diagnostic Complex.

## 1. Domain & Digital Identity
- Primary Production Domain: https://onnesha-hospital.pages.dev
- Future Custom Apex Domain (Deferred — Inactive): https://onneshahospital.com
- Domain Classification: High-Performance Edge Domain with Cloudflare Pages Global Anycast CDN

## 2. Infrastructure & Cloud Hosting Architecture
- Platform Tier: Multi-Tenant Cloud Healthcare Architecture
- Database Architecture: Managed PostgreSQL Relational Database (Supabase Free Plan baseline; automated backups and Point-In-Time-Recovery [PITR] are not enabled on this tier and require project upgrade to Pro tier under Owner Gate G11)
- Web Hosting & Edge CDN: Cloudflare Pages Global Anycast CDN for static client assets
- Document & Scans Storage: Supabase Storage (`medical-documents-vault` bucket with Row-Level Security and time-limited signed URLs)
- Security Architecture: Strict Row-Level Security (RLS) on all tenant tables, TLS 1.2+ in transit with modern cipher suites, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and server-authoritative finance validation
- Operational Model: Production Health Monitoring, Sanitized Error Telemetry, and Fail-Closed Staging CI Deployment Gates

## 3. Application Profile
- Application Type: Enterprise Hospital Information System (HIS / EMR), Outpatient & Inpatient Clinical Suite
- Client Subsystems: Cross-Platform Progressive Web App (PWA) & Tauri 2 Native Desktop Client
- Status: Active Production Web & Client Deployment (Unconditional commissioning pending owner operational gates: payment gateway, SMS, and hardware integration)

## 4. Clinical Capabilities
- Outpatient Department (OPD): Specialist Doctor Consultation, Digital Token Queue, Online Appointments
- Inpatient Department (IPD): Bed Management, Ward/Cabin Admission, Discharge Summaries
- Diagnostics & Pathology: Structured Lab Test Reporting with Pathologist Sign-Off Verification, Printable Token Reports
- Pharmacy & Billing: Fast Thermal POS Invoicing, Real-Time Inventory Management
